goal: Use bounded Jev judgments to help host agents abandon or reframe attractive wrong beliefs after contradictory real evidence, without adding inert calls.

primaryKpi.name: wrong_lean_recovery_rate
primaryKpi.population: held-out cases with an attractive wrong initial lead and later contradictory evidence
primaryKpi.measure: fraction where the host abandons or materially reframes the wrong lead before the final claim
primaryKpi.target: improve over the matched host-only baseline

leadingIndicators: direct lookups and empty-evidence assertions skip Jev
testable checks freeze predictions before observing results
high-cost or difficult-to-reverse actions route through decision-review
guardrails: final correctness and unsupported-assertion rate do not regress
tokens, tool calls, elapsed time, and unnecessary Jev calls remain within frozen budgets
existing offline transport and research tests pass
all request schemas pass structural verification and native dry-run
emitted requests contain only model, state, and questions
decisionRule: ACCEPT only when the 15/15 implementation gate holds and a matched held-out evaluation improves Wrong-Lean Recovery Rate without guardrail regression. Contract-valid typed judgments alone are not evidence of semantic benefit.
